binding_provenance: docs/specs/internal/ops/ml-track/te-new-capabilities-spec.md §5 (locked 2026-05-24, chat QGI-R&D | 002). Pure transform of recipe-similarity-scores artifact; no model re-fit.
m8_r5_note: Describes how the similarity SCORE responds to changes in indicator ALIGNMENT. The model is discriminative, not causal — this is NOT a claim that changing the real-world indicator changes real-world risk.
headroom_interpretation: Headroom is measured from a country's CURRENT cosine to +1.0 (maximum alignment with the crisis profile). For a LOW-zone country (trajectory DIVERGING from the crisis profile, often anti-aligned cosine<0), large headroom therefore reflects PROTECTIVE DISTANCE from the profile — NOT vulnerability. Read headroom together with each country's score zone (see country_zone).
method: Score S = Σ wᵢ·cosᵢ, so ∂S/∂cosᵢ = wᵢ. marginal_points_per_unit = wᵢ * 50 (risk_score = 100*(S+1)/2). headroom = wᵢ*(1−cosᵢ); headroom_points = headroom*50. Ranked by headroom descending.
